```text
# PR #3367: Patch: move the menus' remaining dialogs and sheets onto the shared Dialog

Closes #3221

## Summary

This is the second half of the dialog work begun in #3220. Every menu dialog and sheet that #3221 lists now draws through the shared `<Dialog>`, and so does the Looks screen that opens over the item preview. Where a dialog keeps its own body, ruling **R3221000** says so and gives the reason. The change is to how things look and which keys do what; the client still decides nothing (CLAUDE.md rule 7).

### What changed

- **`game/Dialog.tsx` and `dialog.css`**
  - New props: `id`, `closeTestid`, `closeLabel`, `scrimTestid`, `sheet`, `focus`, `panelRef`, and a `title` that can be any element.
  - Each answer button (`DialogAction`) gains `disabled` and `busy`; `cancel` gains `disabled`.
  - A new exported `DialogClose` draws the one ✕.
  - A `sheet` variant: centred on a wide screen, at the foot of an upright phone (600 px wide and under), down the right edge of a phone on its side (500 px tall and under).
- **Escape and Tab go to the top layer only.**
  - `useBackLayer` now returns `isTop`, and `useModalKeys` and `useModalOverlay` act only when theirs is the top layer. Nested dialogs (Looks over the preview, a card's detail over the card view) close one per Escape, as they already did one per Back.
  - Escape over an open tooltip closes only the tooltip (R279, R2098000), in every dialog.
  - Tab skips hidden tab panels and controls with `tabindex="-1"`.
  - `useBackLayer` now pushes its layer in a layout effect, which fixes a race with the landing page's Escape (R639).
- **Moved onto `<Dialog>`:**
  - Settings, Friends and Chat as sheets. Friends and Chat are now modal.
  - ChallengeDialog, TokenOffer, the shop's chase confirm, and the account delete confirm. Account deletion is now a layer with a `danger` answer.
  - The stats breakdown, DungeonStats' run details, FieldGuide, PatchNotes' card, ItemPreview, CardCosmeticsView, LooksScreen, the DevButton panel, the command menu, and the tutorial result.
- **Keep their own bodies, but take the shared parts:**
  - CardDetail takes the ✕, the `--z-dialog` layer and the dialog's scrim colour.
  - The pack scene takes the ✕, disabled while its open request is out.
- **Close and order conventions**
  - A dialog with a Cancel is an `alertdialog`: Cancel comes first, holds the focus, and is its close. Every other dialog closes with the top-right ✕; no × close is left.
  - The inline confirms put the safe choice first. These are Friends' Block, a series' Forfeit, a quest's Replace, the dungeon's Abandon, and MoveToExisting's Keep.
- **Stacking.** Every dialog scrim sits at `--z-dialog` (72). As a result, Settings (was 1000), the command menu (200) and Chat/Friends (96/90) now draw under the challenge toasts, the undo toast and the queue banner. The ruling states this.
- **Spec and docs**
  - New ruling `spec/rulings/R3221000.md`, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/3221.md`.
  - Amendments to `R2127000.md` and §10.10, and an update to the dialogs paragraph in `apps/web/README.md`.
  - A pending fragment for this visual change, plus zh-CN translations for the new sentences.

### Tests

- **New `apps/web/src/dialogs.test.ts`**, which reads the web sources and checks that:
  - no hand-rolled Escape handler is left outside an allowlist that names each exception;
  - no scrim rule sets a background or a raw z-index outside `dialog.css`;
  - the ✕ glyph appears only in `Dialog.tsx`, and no × is a close;
  - each listed dialog draws through `<Dialog>`;
  - each inline confirm puts its safe choice first.
- **`game/Dialog.test.tsx`** gains R3221000 cases: the new props, disabled and busy answers, the sheet, nested Escape and Tab, Escape over a tooltip, and Tab skipping hidden controls.
- **Existing tests** were updated to the new markup without deleting any case, and the style ratchet counts were lowered, never raised.

### Run this pass

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` | exit 0, all 62 test binaries ok; `apps/web/src/wire` unchanged |

| harness web command (`build-wasm.sh`, then vitest `--project web --changed origin/main`) | 341 files, 6462 passed, 74 skipped; the diff adds no `.skip`, `.only` or lint suppression |

The previous pass ran these, and I did not run them again here:
- the web typecheck and eslint;
- e2e specs 01, 06, 10, 13, 19, 42, 46 and 47, and the pack-opening component spec.

Spec 35 ("a change reaches the account") failed locally on this branch and fails the same way on a local build of main's `b1a40c7bf8`. That evidence is local only; I have no link to CI on main failing it.

### Decisions the task did not settle

- **Chat becomes a modal sheet.** Rejected: leaving it non-modal beside the page.
- **No ✕ beside a Cancel.** A dialog with a Cancel uses it as its only close.
- **One scrim class.** Rejected: a scrim class per caller.
- **`useModalOverlay` stays its own hook.** Moving it onto `useModalKeys` would lose the inspect overlay's long-press guard and stop its Escape short of the board's drag.
- **The command menu takes the ✕** in place of its "Close" beside the input.
- **The inspect overlay's other sheets** (InspectSheet, CardList, FaceDown, StackSheet, HeroInspect) keep their text Close because #3221 does not list them. The ruling names them as exceptions.
```
